post_title: $6K off the price, or a $6K seller credit? Here's the math.
caption:
The seller offers $6K. Off the price, or as a credit? 🤝

Same $6K, different winner depending on what you need most. Head to head:

• Cash to close: the credit saves about $4,300 up front.
• Payment: the price cut is $30 a month lower.
• Cash flow: +$64 vs +$28 a month.
• Cash-on-cash: 0.9% vs 0.4%. Price cut takes it, 3–1.

Short on cash? The credit keeps more money in your pocket.

Example numbers: asking $300K, 25% down, 7% 30-year, 3% closing costs, rent $2,500. Lenders cap seller credits, often at 2% for investment loans.
